# Installing a cluster on IBM PowerVC with customizations {#installing-ibm-powervc-installer-custom}

To install a customized OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_vc_name }}, change the parameters in the `install-config.yaml` file before you run the installation program.
